insights.headline: India gold premiums return as festive demand builds; oil and Fed outlook keep global prices under pressure
insights.summary: India's gold market flipped to premiums of up to $7 an ounce for the first time in three months as festive buying picked up and imports stayed tight. Globally, gold hovered near $4,120-4,135 an ounce: elevated oil prices and a 90%+ priced-in December Fed hike kept a lid on gains, while retreating Treasury yields offered some support. The rupee firmed to 94.45 per dollar on India-US trade deal hopes, easing the landed cost of imported gold.
points: India flipped to gold premiums up to $7/oz for the first time in three months; August imports plunged 45% and September fell to $1.8B.
Russia sold 62 tonnes of gold in ten months, the biggest drawdown since 1998, to fund a 7.3 trillion-ruble budget deficit.
Spot gold held near $4,132 with Brent above $110; traders see an 83% chance the Fed holds rates on Oct 27-28.
Silver's key level is $58.21 per the latest technical read, after a 6%+ slide last week.
Rupee rose 46 paise to 94.45; WGC-BCG sees digital gold growing ~27% a year to $160-170B by 2031.

trending.title: India's festive bid is back — and premiums prove it
trending.summary: Premiums up to $7/oz, the first in three months, show dealers confident of Dhanteras (Nov 6) and Diwali demand as import curbs keep supply tight. WGC notes healthy order flows and improving footfall.

trending.title: Oil versus the Fed: the ceiling on gold
trending.summary: Gold can't break out while crude above $110 feeds inflation fears and the December Fed hike stays 90%+ priced. Yields near 5.08% are near-term support; next week's FOMC guidance decides the next leg.

trending.title: Russia sells, central banks still buy
trending.summary: Russia's 62-tonne sell-off, its largest since 1998, is budget financing via the National Wealth Fund — while central banks overall keep accumulating, what Goldman Sachs calls structural price support.

trending.title: Silver searches for a floor
trending.summary: After losing over 6% last week, silver's fate hangs on $58.21. A weaker silver alongside firmer gold keeps the pair's outlook split into the Fed meeting.

items.title: India Gold Flips To Premiums Up To $7 As Festive Demand Returns
items.summary: India's gold market flipped to premiums of up to $7 an ounce over domestic spot prices last week, the first premium in three months, as festive demand improved and import curbs tightened supply. Dealers had offered $5-6 discounts the week before. Gold imports plunged 45% in August and slipped again in September to $1.8B from $2.3B. Demand peaks around Dhanteras (Nov 6) and Diwali (Nov 8).

items.title: Russia is selling off gold reserves. Why, to whom, and does it matter for the market?
items.summary: Russia sold 6.2 tonnes of gold for a 10th straight month, taking reserves to ~2,270 tonnes - the lowest since late 2019. About 62 tonnes have been sold since December 2025, the biggest drawdown since 1998. Governor Nabiullina says the sales fund a 7.3 trillion-ruble budget deficit via the National Wealth Fund, not a currency crisis; the fund's gold shrank from 555 tonnes in May 2022 to 160 tonnes.

items.title: Gold edges up as oil remains elevated, fueling inflation concerns
items.summary: Spot gold edged up 0.22% to about $4,132.70 an ounce in early Wednesday trade as US Treasury yields retreated, while silver slipped 0.58% to around $57.61. The 10-year yield stood near 5.08%. Markets see an 83% chance the Fed holds rates at its October 27-28 meeting, though a December hike is still widely expected. Elevated oil kept inflation worries in focus.

items.title: US Treasury yields slip as AI concerns boost safe haven demand ahead of 20 year auction
items.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield fell 1.5bps to 5.102% on October 21, a second straight daily decline, as AI-stock volatility pushed investors toward safe havens ahead of a $13 billion 20-year auction. CME FedWatch priced only a 14.9% chance of a hike at the October 28 Fed meeting, down from 33.2% a week ago. The 10-year has fallen 14.6bps this week - its biggest weekly drop in eight months.

items.title: Rupee rises 46 paise to 94.45 on India-US trade deal hopes; oil prices cap gains
items.summary: The rupee strengthened 46 paise to 94.45 per dollar on hopes of an India-US trade deal after President Trump signaled an announcement could come soon, plus RBI measures including dedicated banking arrangements for oil companies. Brent above $110 remains a headwind; LKP Securities sees resistance at 94.25-94.40. The rupee is down 5% this year. A firmer rupee eases the landed cost of imported gold.

items.title: Gold steadies near one-week low as oil-driven inflation fears grow
items.summary: Gold steadied near a one-week low as Brent crude above $110 revived inflation fears ahead of the Fed's October 27-28 meeting. Spot gold held at $4,127.53 an ounce after touching its lowest since October 15; futures edged up 0.1% to $4,145.70. Silver slid 0.7% to $57.6. A Reuters poll found nearly all economists expect the Fed to hold next week, with a December hike priced in.

items.title: Gold Prices Decline Ahead of Dhanteras Festivities
items.summary: MCX gold fell for a fourth straight session on October 21, with December futures down 0.42% at Rs 1,45,898 per 10 grams and silver down 1.16% at Rs 2,09,028 per kg, as high crude prices fanned inflation worries. PTI reported December gold fell Rs 509 to Rs 1,46,010. Enrich Money's Ponmudi R pegged support at Rs 1,45,300-1,46,000 and resistance at Rs 1,48,000-1,48,600 ahead of Dhanteras.

items.title: Silver at a Decision Point: $58.21 Holds the Key to Recovery
items.summary: Silver faces a decisive test around $58.21 an ounce, the level the analysis flags as key to any recovery after the metal lost more than 6% last week. The piece frames $58.21 as the pivot: holding it could reopen the upside, while losing it risks deeper losses. Technical read only; levels attributed to the source.

items.title: Gold ETFs to Watch Amid Fed Rate Hike & Oil Risks
items.summary: Gold ETFs remain sensitive to Fed policy expectations and Middle East developments, Zacks notes: oil-driven inflation could lift rate expectations rather than deliver automatic safe-haven gains. SPDR Gold Shares fell over 4% in the month to October 14 ($142B assets); iShares Gold Trust fell 4.6% ($62.17B); SPDR Gold MiniShares dropped over 4% ($31.08B).

items.title: Digital Gold Market To Reach $170 Billion By 2031: WGC
items.summary: The World Gold Council and BCG estimate digital gold could grow ~27% a year from $45-55 billion to $160-170 billion by 2031, with up to $700 billion in latent demand if barriers fall. A survey across 12 markets found 9 in 10 investors would consider digital gold if concerns were addressed. India is central: 120M+ customers have transacted, though SEBI warns such products sit outside its purview.

items.title: PC Jeweller Q2 results: Net profit soars 58% YoY to Rs 331 crore, EBITDA surges 74%
items.summary: PC Jeweller's Q2FY27 net profit jumped 58% YoY to Rs 331 crore on revenue of Rs 1,054 crore (+28%), driven by festive and wedding-season demand; operating EBITDA rose 74% with margins at 29.3%. The company repaid all consortium bank dues ahead of schedule and is now debt-free. It plans up to 100 new showrooms in 12-18 months and a new jewellery brand aimed at younger buyers.
